creative_direction.name: Basalt Court Noon Shadow
creative_direction.brief: 把盖顶的镜面碎光放进一座正午石庭：深玄武岩灰石板墙以细密干缝排成横向石层，连续 honed 同料石板地面在真实基准线接墙；正午顶光在墙根压出一道锐利水平影带，石面保持冷哑光。商品缩小立于石地偏右，测量接触阴影陷进干缝；左半幅石墙保持安静，承载一根 Century Gothic 文字柱：品牌字居柱顶、几何大写题名以柱宽三行排印如仪器铭牌，一条柠檬短横线垫于柱底如日晷刻度。垂直方向与盖肩重叠、水平方向宽距分离，双栏网格诚实成立；玄武岩的冷哑光与金黄折面玻璃的暖透互为温度悖论。参考 R1 的左图右文负空间层级、R4 的硬方向光阴影秩序与 R8 的深色建筑感负空间。
creative_direction.material: dark basalt stone slab wall with fine dry joints and continuous honed basalt ground
creative_direction.lighting: bright noon top light casting one sharp horizontal shadow band at the wall base, cool diffuse ambient on the wall face, no hard shadows on the standing subject

background.prompt: Dark basalt grey stone slab wall with fine horizontal dry joints meeting a continuous honed matching basalt ground at a horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame, one sharp horizontal shadow band lying along the wall base from noon top light, matte stone grain, cool diffuse ambient, no objects
